### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of cooked chicken, broccoli, a slice of pepperoni pizza, roasted potato pieces, and a creamy dressed green salad.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using a 26 cm circular equivalent for the requested calculation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².**
The square shape and partially cropped edge introduce some uncertainty.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: chicken pieces, broccoli florets, pepperoni-and-cheese pizza, skin-on roasted potatoes, lettuce, and creamy dressing. Any cooking oil is included in the cooked-food energy estimates rather than counted separately.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Dressing overlaps the lettuce, so it adds volume and weight but no additional covered plate area.

| Item | Plate coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chicken | 18% | 95 × 1.3 = 124 ml | 1.0 | 124 g | 190 | 236 kcal |
| Broccoli | 12% | 64 × 2.8 = 179 ml | 0.5 | 89 g | 35 | 31 kcal |
| Pepperoni pizza | 16% | 85 × 1.2 = 102 ml | 0.9 | 92 g | 280 | 258 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 9% | 48 × 1.7 = 82 ml | 0.6 | 49 g | 140 | 69 kcal |
| Lettuce | 26% | 138 × 2.4 = 331 ml | 0.18 | 60 g | 17 | 10 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | Overlapping | 138 × 0.145 = 20 ml | 1.0 | 20 g | 450 | 90 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 18 + 12 + 16 + 9 + 26 = **81%**, consistent with a mostly occupied plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **434 g and approximately 694 kcal**. This is plausible for the visible meal: the salad occupies substantial space but weighs relatively little, while the pizza, chicken, and dressing supply most of the energy. Potato identification and dressing quantity are the largest uncertainties.
